{{Quote|A few years ago, Beryl and I robbed an Imperial treasury station. The heist went bad. I escaped, Beryl didn't.|Risha Drayen|<ref name="The Vault" />}}
'''Imperial Pay Station RMH-1973''' was a pay station operated by the [[Imperial Treasury Department]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> A few [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place in [[3643 BBY]] per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates/1|here]]. Additionally, {{TORcite|type=class|Smuggler|The Vault|Taris}} in Act I states that the [[raid on Imperial Pay Station RMH-1973]] occurred a few [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior.</ref> the criminals [[Beryl Thorne]] and [[Risha Drayen]] orchestrated an armed [[Raid on Imperial Pay Station RMH-1973|heist]] of the pay station. The heist went sour; Thorne was captured<ref name="The Vault" /> and the Treasury Department issued a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] of one million [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] on "Risha Xanthous," the alias that Drayen was using at the [[Time/Legends|time]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

==Behind the scenes==
Imperial Pay Station RMH-1973 was first mentioned in the [[Voidhound|smuggler]] class mission "The Vault" in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]],<ref name="The Vault" /> although it was not named until the release of the [[2012]] reference guide ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
